summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting entry into employment agreements with interim CEO Brady Cobb and interim COO Michael Bondurant. The agreements specify base salaries of $300,000 and $275,000, cash bonuses tied to market capitalization increases (up to $50,000 each at thresholds of $5M and $10M, plus 3% above $10M capped at $300,000), and option grants of 231,250 and 200,000 shares respectively, with RSUs subject to shareholder approval. The filing details compensation mechanics but does not state the reason for interim appointments or any departure. The event is the appointment of interim executives, marking a management change.
